pages.text: The cities are not unguarded. The $(l)Echo Sentinel$(/l) is a floating construct that still keeps watch — it charges and fires a $(o)light-pulse beam$(). It haunts the Undercrown and the vaults.
Defeat one for $(l)resonance core fragments$(/l), $(l)luminite$(/l), $(l)memory crystal shards$(/l), and rarely a $(l)Lumen Relay$(/l) — the parts you need to rebuild the Lumenwrights' tech.
